title: Unit 8 Regional Consolidation: Panama
goal: Synthesize understanding of Panamanian geography, canal geopolitics, Afro-Antillean memory, and comarcal governance in a comprehensive case study.
grammar: síntesis del modelo territorial, logístico y social de Panamá

items: Evaluate the geological origin of the isthmus and the ecological role of the Darién Gap.
Trace the diplomatic and social history leading to the 1977 Torrijos-Carter treaties and full sovereignty.
Recognize the labor struggles, segregation, and cultural legacy of Afro-Antillean communities.
Analyze the logistics and financial hub model alongside territorial inequality.
Examine Guna Yala's autonomous governance and pioneering climate change resettlement.
I can describe the physical geography of the isthmus and the Darién Gap.
I understand the historical struggle for canal sovereignty and the meaning of January 9, 1964.
I can discuss the Afro-Antillean heritage and its influence on Panamanian music and society.
I can explain Guna Yala's comarca system and the climate challenge faced by Gardi Sugdub.
